context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the create-retrospective instructions from the published agnostic-planning-skills tile.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Generate a structured retrospective focused on learning and actionable improvements.

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: DO NOT skip action items — every "what didn't" must have at least one action.

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Identify themes** — group related feedback into themes rather than listing raw comments.

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Draft action items** — specific, owned, time-bound. Use the template in [RETROSPECTIVE_TEMPLATE.md](./RETROSPECTIVE_TEMPLATE.md) if available; otherwise use the minimal template below.

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Review** — verify every "what didn't" maps to an action item.

checklist.name: instruction-6
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Use **[RETROSPECTIVE_TEMPLATE.md](./RETROSPECTIVE_TEMPLATE.md)** if bundled; otherwise use this minimal fallback:

checklist.name: instruction-7
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Section order: header → What Went Well → What Didn't → Action Items → Metrics → Kudos. Use English unless the user requests otherwise.
